web_fixture.title: Ledger format revisions - Marlbeck
web_fixture.snippet: New Marlbeck writers emit ledger format revision 32; older exports keep the revision they were written with.
web_fixture.content:
# Ledger format revisions

Marlbeck, reviewed 2026-06-30.

| revision | first writer | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 32 | marlbeck-writer 4.0 | current; adds the settled_at column |
| 29 | marlbeck-writer 3.2 | still read by every tool |
| 24 | marlbeck-writer 2.8 | read only by the archive importer |

New exports are written with revision 32 and the header names that revision. The
revision a file carries never changes after the export, so an old export still
says 29 and a very old one still says 24.

web_fixture.title: Revision 29 notes - Marlbeck
web_fixture.snippet: Exports written with ledger revision 29 keep the older column order.
web_fixture.content:
# Revision 29 notes

Marlbeck, archived note.

Exports written with revision 29 keep the older column order and carry no
settled_at column, so a reader that needs that column falls back to the header.
Revision 29 files stay valid and are never rewritten.

turns.prompt: Marlbeck writes the ledger files our archive service takes in. Which format revision do new Marlbeck exports carry? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
